# Vivtone

> Vivtone is a leading provider of FDA-approved, rechargeable OTC hearing aids in multiple styles (CIC, RIC, BTE) with Bluetooth connectivity and advanced noise cancellation features.

Vivtone specializes in affordable, accessible hearing solutions for mild to moderate hearing loss, offering invisible and discreet models with modern technology like Bluetooth connectivity, app control, and sustainable rechargeable batteries. The company provides comprehensive customer support including lifetime assistance, detailed user guides, and a 45-day satisfaction guarantee.

## Key Topics

- Bluetooth hearing aids
- OTC hearing aids
- Rechargeable hearing aids
- CIC (Completely-in-Canal)
- RIC (Receiver-in-Canal)
- BTE (Behind-the-Ear)
- Vivtone XPURE
- Vivtone Supermini-b3
- FDA-registered
- Noise cancellation
- Invisible hearing aids
- Hearing aid comparison
- IP65 waterproof
- DSP technology
- Money-back guarantee
